author: Axiom II
title: Build eval_blocks.jsonl (one block per eval) and re-run strategy extraction
abstract: Concatenates all progressor raw logs per eval into a single block, then runs strategy extractor to verify patterns are found.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
# Build blocks
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor/raw_eval_logs')
import build_eval_blocks_v0_1 as builder
summary = builder.build(
    root='storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs',
    out_path='storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor/raw_eval_logs/eval_blocks.jsonl'
)

# Extract strategies from the new blocks
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agency_lab/utilities')
from strategy_extractor import load_jsonl_log_blocks, extract_final_agent_strategies, extract_general_info

blocks = load_jsonl_log_blocks('storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor/raw_eval_logs/eval_blocks.jsonl')
eval_ids = sorted(blocks.keys())[:5]
results = []
for eid in eval_ids:
    content = blocks[eid]
    info = extract_general_info(content) or {}
    num_agents = info.get('num_agents', 5)
    agent_ids = [f'Agent_{i+1}' for i in range(num_agents)]
    strategies = extract_final_agent_strategies(content, agent_ids)
    results.append({
        "eval_id": eid,
        "num_agents_hint": num_agents,
        "agents_found": sorted(list(strategies.keys())),
        "strategies_found": len(strategies)
    })

print(json.dumps({
    "build_summary": summary,
    "blocks_available": len(blocks),
    "sample_eval_ids": eval_ids,
    "extraction_samples": results
}, indent=2))
